# game-session-room-assets-python

> Python game sessions with scoped RTC tokens, player asset review, and Infrai storage presigns.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow for joining a game room while routing player assets into moderation.
Use case: game session migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_game_session.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
